decision.about: Make needs a selection scheme over its middle pane. Its own event and ring, or ext/Panel's?

options.why: The event already carries 'the selected thing or null' with no import either way; the ring becomes one declaration with two arms.

options.say: A `paging-make-focus` event and a ring of Make's own
options.why: No coupling at all between the realms, and no guards needed in ext/Panel.

decision.because: Two editors on one site with two slightly different ideas of what selected looks like is how the second one drifts. Sharing cost two guards for a detail with no root(), written at the line.

decision.about: How does a click reach a run of text inside a block?

options.say: Two clicks: the block first, then the run
options.why: ext/Panel's own drill() idea; the block stays reachable.

decision.because: A prose block is covered edge to edge by its own paragraphs, so innermost-wins means the block itself can never be selected.

decision.about: Where do the three add-a-block buttons go?

options.say: One Add a block button on the page; the three kinds are the BLOCK's first row
options.why: The page pane keeps only what is about the page; the kind is about the block.

options.say: Keep Prose / Card wall / Template on the page
options.why: One click instead of two to get a card wall.

decision.because: Three controls for a choice you can make afterwards, on a pane that is supposed to be about the page. The block's kind row was specified anyway.

decision.about: How are an element's three words stored and applied?

options.say: `block.runs[i]`, applied by dress() in make/page.js on both drawings
options.why: The markdown stays markdown; one applier, two callers, both inside the fence.

options.say:
Rewrite the markdown to carry the class (`

`)
options.why: No applier at all, and the printed page.js would be exactly right.

decision.because: These files are meant to be hand-edited and a heading would lose its ##. The cost is written down: a `?nest=` read through core's Page.from() shows the run undressed, and the Code tab does not print the words.

decision.about: What does `size: large` do to a run?

options.why: Scales the box the element already is; an h2 stays an h2, 30% bigger. Measured 43.6px -> 56.7px.

decision.because: font-size REPLACES a heading's size rather than scaling it -- large on an h2 shrank it from 34.9px to 20.2px -- and in @layer theme it lost silently to the skin's (0,2,0) heading rule. Both measured.

decision.about: The bar's two split buttons in the rail: one row or two?

options.why: Every other row in this rail is one tag and one set of buttons.

options.say: Two rows, one button each, as the brief's wording says

decision.because: Two rows holding one button each would be the only rows in the rail shaped differently -- the kind of drift that made the bar unreadable in the first place.

decision.about: With `tune` deleted, how does a panel's rail open?

options.say: Selecting a panel docks the rail (tools.js)
options.why: It is the only door left; dock() is idempotent so pages that dock at load are unaffected.

options.say: Leave it: only pages that dock() at load get a rail
options.why: Keeps the owner's 2026-08-18 'too jumpy' verdict untouched.

decision.because: The August verdict was right in a world where `tune` existed. With the bar deleted, a panel in ext/editor or a one-off panel(fn) would have no way to reach its own words at all.

decision.about: Fold the playground's document rail into Make's tree -- redirect the page, or thin it?

options.say: A thin wrapper: one line above the Workspace, linking back to Make
options.why: Keeps the viewport set and the drawer grip, which Make has not got.

options.say: Redirect /playground/<name>/ to Make and delete the page

decision.because: What the playground has that Make does not is the Workspace chrome. A redirect would delete a working tool to save a file. What folded is the rail, not the page.

decision.about: The notes say a selected panel has no name. Re-add the leaf head to ext/Panel's rail?

options.why: The 2026-08-19 sweep removed it because the template dropdown directly under it says the same thing, and the drawer slot already reads `panel`.
The notes called its absence a defect.

decision.because: A measured prior decision, and the same thing twice in two rows is one thing too many. The name badge the notes were really asking for is in Make's middle, where the selected thing genuinely had none.

assign.outcome:
**One selection scheme over Make, one sidebar that shows only the selected thing, and ext/Panel's floating bar deleted.**

Click anything in [Make](/imagine/paging/make/)'s middle pane - the page, a block, a run of text - and it gets one outline and one name badge, the tree row lights up, and the right pane empties and refills with the few controls that thing can take. Escape clears; so does clicking off.

![](1-page.png)
![](2-block.png)
![](3-element.png)

**Controls on screen in the right pane, counted live at 1600**

| editing | before | after |
|---|---:|---:|
| a page with no blocks | 15 | **13** |
| a page with three blocks | 27 | **13** |
| one block | 27 - all of them, always | **5** |
| one run of text | not possible | **8** |
| nothing | not possible | **0**, and one sentence |

The page's own rows barely moved, and that is the honest result: a title, a description, an icon and the realm's seven words really are all about the page. What left is everything that was about something else.

**Lines.** `ext/Panel/toolbar.js` deleted (63); Make's tree 343 -> 228 on [`ux/Tree`](/framework/ux/Tree/), which brought folding and a keyboard with it; `workspace.js` -18; `playground/page.js` -24. `toolbar.css` is `controls.css` - one `.panel-btn` box and the strip the drag grip rides on. Split and close are rows in the rail; selecting a panel opens it, because `tune` was the only other door.

![](4-panel-rail.png)

**Proven headless**, 13 pages at 1600 with zero console errors, including every real `ext/Panel` importer. A tree row dragged by its grip onto Archive's middle moved the page into it and `made/archive/page.json` came back `children:[...]` - `ux/Tree`'s `move` event reaching `apply()` reaching the disk. `made/` is byte-identical to the copy taken before the first edit.

**Left, with reasons** - a `page.json` read by `?nest=` shows a run's three words undressed (that path is core's `Page.from()`, not Make's); the Code tab does not print them (`build/words.js`, outside the fence); ext/Panel's leaf still gets no name head (a measured 2026-08-19 decision - the template dropdown under it says the same thing).
